Two people: Shen Yuetang stands in front of the brass oil lamp facing the camera; Fu Bo in his grey Chinese jacket stands behind her on screen left, in front of the medicine cabinet. Not smiling. She slowly unfolds her hands and holds them in front of her, palms up, and looks down at her own hands; Fu Bo steps back half a step and bows his head. Her mouth stays closed the whole time; she does not speak. Fu Bo's mouth is closed.
data.motion: She slowly opens her folded hands, palms up, and looks down at them; Fu Bo steps back and bows his head.
